stem: High-risk HPV types such as 16 and 18 are linked to which neoplastic pathway?

options.label: A
options.text: Only flaccid paralysis after wild poliovirus infection
options.misconception: Polio. (does not match the cited teaching point).

options.label: B
options.text: Cervical abnormalities that can progress to cancer

options.label: C
